text: The minimum number of cards to be dealt from an arbitrarily shuffled deck of 52 cards to guarantee that three cards are from some same suit is
solution: Worst case before the guarantee: 2 cards from each of the 4 suits = 8 cards, with no suit yet holding 3. The 9th card must join one of those suits, giving 3 of a suit. Generalised pigeonhole: to force r in some box out of k boxes you need k(r-1)+1 = 4(2)+1 = 9.
source_label: GATE 2000 solutions (solutionsadda); also Garg's Academy GATE combinatorics solutions
